_comment: UNAUDITED-ARC(2): entPhysicalVendorType.1 in this part answers an OID under 1.3.6.1.4.1.2. nl6#821 typed that column as an OBJECT IDENTIFIER, so the value reaches the wire as an identity claim. The arc itself IS checked: TestEveryProfileServesOnlyItsOwnVendorArc requires ibm_power_s922.json to serve PEN 2 and no other vendor's number. The value below the number has not been read against any IBM MIB. Refs nl6#590, nl6#821.
